test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**most**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase “to give priority to” implies choosing what is of the highest importance or urgency.
 
• Out of the given options, **"most"** is the superlative form used to express the greatest degree of urgency.
 
• “More” is comparative and used when comparing two things, which is not the case here.
 
• “High” is an adjective, not a degree word that fits grammatically in this structure.
 
• “Least” means minimum importance, which contradicts the idea of giving priority.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage (so far): *It **makes__** no discriminations to nationality, race, religious beliefs, class or political opinions. It endeavours to **__relieve__** the suffering of individuals, being guided solely by **__their__** needs, and to give priority to the **__most__** urgent cases of distress...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Most (सबसे अधिक):** Indicates the highest degree – ideal with "urgent cases".
 
• **More (अधिक):** Comparative, used between two items – not suitable here.
 
• **High (उच्च):** Adjective – grammatically incorrect in this structure.
 
• **Least (सबसे कम):** Opposite of what “priority” implies – incorrect in meaning.
